prompts.task: Perform a focused read-only supplemental audit and propose source-backed per-function producer decisions and concrete future acceptance in .observe/per-function-decorator-audit.md and .json. Do not execute SDK/probes or close canonical findings from this snapshot. Use per-function-decorator-gate-evidence.json as independent source evidence, not live app.py state. The exact original demo7932ce33 snapshots contain agent.call_model and tools.execute_tool/tools.retrieve_documents coroutines plus agent.run_agent async generator. Assess every function separately with actual path/qualified name, span_type, shape, pre-existing ownership, native SDK @log source/probe capabilities for raw capture/privacy, protocol/lifecycle/partial/close/cancel, creation-time kind/attributes and sink, chosen function pattern, exact applicable limitation, test acceptance and remaining proof. SDK async/async-generator dispatch support is real supplied source evidence; do not reject a shape merely because it yields or is async. Current source can make direct native capture unsafe through raw-input overwrite, full model response capture, result/null/partial behavior or document content/identity adaptation; source facts and unavailable current runtime support must stay separate. Preserve existing OTel/Galileo producer/export paths, fill only gaps, and never add a duplicate producer. A public helper may be used inside a justified application-owned FUNCTION decorator; bare with/manual scopes on new functions, helper-first preference, post-export sanitization or a redacted companion do not implement this gate. Non-function lifetimes and pre-existing owned scopes are separate. Do not invent a helper kind argument or fix CLIENT/initial-attribute limits by late enrichment. Read supplied files only: no original demo/fixture/code/input/dependency/profile/test/skill/global edits, package installation/import, SDK/model/app/probe/receiver/registry/cloud/network execution or UI/browser. Write only the named supplemental.observe artifacts. Dated versions are scoped evidence; actual future application still needs task-time newest-compatible resolution, selected public APIs and immutable checked apply. Keep unexecuted compatibility/runtime/receiver/creation-time claims Not run/Not proven.

judge_inputs: Read the shared source evidence, loaded target skill/shared AO gate and generated supplemental Markdown/JSON, actor trace, last_message and grade. Source snapshots remain separate from real fixtureapp.py. Compare actual chosen per-function producer patterns and acceptance, not headings, decorator keyword counts or generic copied rules.

Return exactly six ordered rubric checks with IDs rubric-1 through rubric-6. Equivalent precise prose/JSON/grouping is accepted only if every actual function/candidate decision and evidence is individually locatable. These tasks are read-only plan/source assessments; no SDK installation, actual probe/app/receiver/cloud execution is required or fabricated.

Input contains exact source/receipt/probe facts and neutral implementation candidates, not the selection/verdict answer ledger. Current SDK graph, safe_capture implementation, real fallback execution and native routing are unavailable; assess precise source limits while preserving historical facts and existing producers.
rubric: Identifies all four exact demo functions and actual coroutine/async-generator/span_type/ownership/dataflow separately. call_model remote Ollama versus local rule engine is conditional source applicability; execute_tool/search_docs->retrieve_documents nested operations and run_agent single invocation are preserved, without fake workflow/extra wrappers or attributing snapshots to fixtureapp.py.

Assesses public native SDK @log first for each fresh function from exact dated source/native-probe and installed-source receipts. Distinguishes supported dispatch from raw-input overwrite/privacy, full model response/hidden fields, null/partial output, document schema, bounded collection/protocol/close/cancel and sink/creation-time gaps; unsupported or unexecuted facts remain explicit. A blanket async/generator/custom-sink blocker or generic helper preference is not a capability decision. Uses the fresh public localhost native probe as scoped real SDK capture, not cloud/app proof: safe dispatch/async-generator output exists; raw mapped/redacted sentinel remains in canonical native tool content, null/error empty-object capture is not a real produced result, model-shaped JSON lacks native usage/finish mapping, and demo-shaped documents are emitted as serialized Document.content with empty metadata rather than rejected/dropped. Native business-call current context remains the agent rather than the leaf; this limits nested transport correlation even when exported leaf parentage exists. Do not invent native rejection or dismiss ordinary public SDK routing because a private/custom sink is unavailable.

Where native public configuration meets a safe source contract, proposes/retains native function decoration. Any fallback has a precise applicable source/probe mismatch and a named application-owned FUNCTION decorator around a supported same-boundary creator, preserving business inputs/results/errors and one producer. Direct manual context-manager scopes for a fresh function do not satisfy this requirement even when SDK span fields look correct; post-export filtering or redacted companion does not suppress original SDK capture. Unsupported helper CLIENT/initial attribute arguments, private injection and duplicate spans fail. A read-only source proposal may leave CLIENT or initial-attribute capability unresolved, but the affected capability/implementation must remain Partial or Not proven; it must not call an incompatible creator fully supported or invent unsupported arguments. A concrete proposed decorator symbol/attachment and a scoped pattern decision are still required.

Provides concrete scoped fallback/native acceptance for raw-secret absence before every SDK/native/export path, same-span content equality and null/no-result/produced-partial preservation, actual parent/count, cancellation/re-raised errors, normal iteration/early close and any unknown send/asend/throw/athrow contract. Async-generator run_agent remains eligible in principle; finite step count alone does not bound content/history, and sampler/on_start/public sink/runtime proof is not invented.

Preserves independently pre-existing OTel and Galileo producer/provider/export ownership, including their manual source scopes, rather than retroactively rewriting them solely to fit the new-function decorator gate. Existing field/lifecycle proof gaps can be enriched/tested separately without claiming migration, adding a second creator or treating Galileo export processing as fresh span creation.

Audit records concrete proposed native-first decisions or exactly justified function-decorator fallbacks in finding-like required_fix/evidence/acceptance content, with all four boundaries individually addressable. Source support is not measured compatibility, installed emission or completed fallback testing. Correct source proposals remain proposed; no unsupported whole-app Pass or live AO/receiver claim.
